summary: Implemented Theorem 3 Schönhage-Strassen two-stage DFT integer multiplication network, dropping degree bound from linear O(d) to sub-linear O(d^{3/4}) with < 1100(d+1) edges and < 136(d+1)^{3/4} maximum degree.
notes: Verified exhaustive acceptance on valid products and rejection on invalid products for d in 1..3. Proved symbolic edge and degree bounds for d up to 1024, confirming sublinear degree scaling relative to the baseline 2d+1 oracle.
